**Question:** What was Nike's revenue in its most recently reported quarter, and which fiscal quarter and date range was that?
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Total revenues (USD millions, as reported/GAAP) | Total revenues (USD billions, as reported/GAAP) | Revenue change, reported (%) | Revenue change, currency-neutral/non-GAAP (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NIKE, Inc. — Q1 FY2027 (three months ended August 31, 2026) | $11,213 [1] | $11.2 billion [1] | -4% [1] | -5% [1] |

- NIKE, Inc.'s most recently reported quarter is the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the three months ended August 31, 2026 (June 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026). [1]
- Total NIKE, Inc. revenues for Q1 FY2027, the quarter ended August 31, 2026, were $11,213 million, as reported (GAAP). [1]
- On a headline basis, first quarter revenues were $11.2 billion, down 4 percent on a reported basis and down 5 percent on a currency-neutral (non-GAAP) basis. [1]
- Within Q1 FY2027, NIKE Brand revenues were $10,952 million, down 4 percent on a reported and currency-neutral basis, and Converse revenues were $263 million, down 28 percent on a reported and currency-neutral basis. [1]

**Not available**
- Q1 FY2027 full financial statements and notes (Form 10-Q): As of 2026-10-01 the quarter is earnings-release only; the 10-Q has not yet been filed, so full financial statements and notes are unavailable. [1]
- Q2 FY2027 (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) revenue: The quarter is still in progress and has not been reported as of 2026-10-01. [1]
